queries: CoreWeave 2025 results gross margin depreciation six years 2026

sources_considered.why: A secondary ratio prompted inspection of the underlying filing; the ratio does not resolve the claim's cost boundary.
Audited financial statements and depreciation policies reveal why different margin calculations cannot be treated as interchangeable.
Read and considered. Its adjusted EBITDA and operating margins are different measures from the provisional gross-margin reading.

evidence_items.locator: Note 2, Property and Equipment; Results of Operations
evidence_items.explanation: The filing lists a six-year technology-equipment life, but records server depreciation in technology and infrastructure expense. Subtracting only reported cost of revenue produces a 71.68% annual ratio; that excludes relevant costs and covers a different period, so it is not a decisive counterexample.

metric_scope.metric: Derived revenue-minus-cost-of-revenue ratio, excluding separately classified technology and infrastructure expense

inputs: Both inputs appear in CoreWeave's audited financial statements; the derived ratio is an evaluator calculation.

unresolved_gaps: The claim supplies no accounting basis or sufficiently precise margin definition.
No matching industry-wide evidence establishes a 70% ceiling.
A six-year depreciation policy does not establish the claimed break-even requirement.
The claim gives no measurable obsolescence threshold.
